extension.description: Browse and play audiobooks and podcasts from your AudioBookShelf server.
extension.news: v0.18.1 Restore audio-only categorisation. The addon shows under Music add-ons only; the v0.18.0 video-too categorisation made the i (info) button no-op when launched from Video add-ons. VideoPlayer playback is still the default — player selection is driven by the ListItem's VideoInfoTag, not by the addon's category.
